theorems_only_on_branches.name: archetype_coverage
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ a : Archetype, ∃ g ∈ allGuilds, g.archetype = a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: collapse_preservation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ g : Guild, ∀ i : Indeterminacy, collapse g i = g.domain

theorems_only_on_branches.name: common_source
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ g1 g2 : Guild, ∃ d1 d2 : String, collapse g1 primordialI = d1 ∧ collapse g2 primordialI = d2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: complementarity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ g1 g2 : Guild, g1 ∈ allGuilds → g2 ∈ allGuilds → g1.archetype ≠ g2.archetype → g1.domain ≠ g2.domain
